lessons.title: Opening Stage
lessons.description: Start with a clear structure, establish the task, ask productive questions, and help the group get underway.

lessons.title: Middle Stage
lessons.description: Make substantive contributions using relevant ideas, evidence, explanation, and connections.

lessons.title: Final Stage
lessons.description: Summarize and synthesize viewpoints, check the task, build consensus, and close professionally.

lessons.title: Before the Round
lessons.description: Prepare equipment, access tasks, get settled, and connect respectfully before a Discussion round.
